# Agent-Friendly Services

> Find services for user tasks and compare access requirements, reviewed outcomes and costs.

## Query

- [Catalog JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Olorinm/agent-friendly-services/main/generated/catalog.json): categories, subcategories, services, access routes, personal eligibility, published costs and route-specific task observations.
- [Results JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Olorinm/agent-friendly-services/main/generated/evaluations.json): frozen tasks, outcomes, run conditions, tokens, service charges and evidence paths.
- [MCP setup and parameters](./mcp/README.md): `search_services` filters candidates; `get_service` returns full service details.
- Example: `search_services({"subcategory":"travel/flights"})`, then `get_service({"id":"kiwi"})`.

Start with the user's domain and constraints. Inspect candidate routes and relevant task records before recommending a service. Report why it fits, access requirements, observed results, costs, evidence dates and unresolved gaps. Official entry URLs are in the catalog.

A documented route is not a task pass. Results apply only to the recorded route, task/version and setup; unknown costs are not zero. Cached input tokens are included in input totals. Setup outside the measured run is disclosed separately. Do not infer a general ranking from isolated trials or contact/register with a provider merely to query this directory.
